SELECT s.*, COALESCE(repo.cnt, 0) AS repository_count, COALESCE(kv.cnt, 0) AS knowledge_version_count, repo.last_decompile_at AS last_decompile_at FROM ci_system s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(last_decompile_at) AS last_decompile_at FROM ci_repository WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY system_id ) repo ON repo.system_id = s.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT system_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ci_knowledge_version WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY system_id ) kv ON kv.system_id = s.id
s.is_deleted = 0
AND s.name LIKE '%' || #{name,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND s.component LIKE '%' || #{component,jdbcType=VARCHAR} || '%'
AND s.owner = #{owner}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ci_repository r WHERE r.system_id = s.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.last_published_version_id IS NOT NULL )
ORDER BY s.created_date DESC
